task.title: P6-130: Stop stale Next page link from reverting text the user just typed
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-130. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**A stale "Next page →" silently reverts the text the user just typed** (was `P6-042b`). The previous result set's link stays clickable while a newer search is in flight (the `Transition` keeps the old view); clicking it navigates to `(old_q, old_cursor)`, after which `QueryBar`'s re-seed effect reverts the box to `old_q`. Self-consistent but the most user-visible item in the old paging bundle.
